Method of Attack: Altering Windows registry app paths to redirect control.exe app path to malicious payload, leveraging auto-elevation of sdclt.exe to bypass UAC and load malware without security warnings
Attack Vector: Modification of HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\control.exe registry key by low-privileged users to point to malware, then launching sdclt.exe to execute the malicious payload
Indicators of Compromise: New or altered registry entries in HKCU\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\control.exe
